title: Chimichurri Sauce
description: Parsley, oregano and garlic in olive oil and red wine vinegar, rested so the raw edges mellow.

steps.do: Mince the onion, bell pepper, parsley, oregano, and garlic fine, so no single piece dominates a bite.
Combine everything in a bowl — oil, vinegar, all the minced ingredients, pepper flakes — and whisk until it comes together.
Season with salt and pepper. Let it stand at least 30 minutes before serving so the flavors settle in. Whisk again just before it goes to the table.

notes: Timing. The half hour of rest is the source's one instruction, and it matters more than anything else here: raw garlic and vinegar need it to stop tasting sharp and separate.
Keeping it. Refrigerate in a jar up to about 5 days. The oil will firm up cold — bring it back to room temperature and whisk before serving.
Serving. Made for grilled beef, but it works on chicken, fish, roasted potatoes, or a fried egg.

source.name: Williams Sonoma Grill Master by Fred Thompson, p. 58
